status: Competitive-team development evaluation complete; final events remain untouched

team_source.name: VGCPastes Champions M-C catalog, distributed through MunchStats
team_source.attribution: Team data from the VGCPastes Repository; fetched via MunchStats' public teams-data branch.
team_source.filter: Top 64 or better, six distinct complete sets, exact published SP spreads only
team_source.legal_validation: 94 of 94 normalized six-Pokemon teams passed the local Showdown Gen 9 Champions Doubles 2026 M-C Closed team validator.
team_source.redistribution_note: Raw public source is cached locally for reproducibility and attribution. No separate redistribution license was identified; do not redistribute the cached team file.

split.method: Tournament-event holdout; no event or exact roster crosses development/final.

evaluation.design: 25 fixed development team-pair clusters, four outcome repeats per pair, both seat orders, same paired seeds and Round402 learned preview selector for all arms.
evaluation.opponent: Max Damage baseline; public-view path is exercised, full information-boundary certification remains open

round430_ppo.information_boundary: policy player-view path; broader audit still open

evaluation.interpretation: Both agents scored below 50% against Max Damage at this sample size. The wide intervals and paired interval crossing zero make the relative ranking inconclusive. This is a small competitive-team development benchmark, not final evidence or an optimal-play claim.
evaluation.fault_found_and_fixed: The initial run found that poke-env raises KeyError when a custom-format move omits optional priority. The public counterplay baseline now treats missing priority as Showdown's default of zero; rerun completed with no errors.
